query: What minimum ethics/IRB and cross-border data-transfer templates and local partner responsibilities are required, and what capacity-building tasks will ensure compliance across jurisdictions?

response.query: What minimum ethics/IRB and cross-border data-transfer templates and local partner responsibilities are required, and what capacity-building tasks will ensure compliance across jurisdictions?
response.answer: Minimum ethics/IRB templates include informed consent and data transfer agreements. Local partners must comply with cross-border data-transfer regulations and conduct capacity-building tasks. Compliance across jurisdictions requires adherence to international cybersecurity standards.
